rationale: Genome-wide KO screen in mESCs carrying an IAPEz (ERV) reporter that confers blasticidin resistance when the ERV is de-repressed; knockouts of ERV-restriction factors (m6A writers Mettl3/Mettl14/Wtap/Zc3h13) survive blasticidin and are enriched in +blast cells. Screen II late selection has two replicates per arm (+blast vs -blast), paired by replicate (1 residual df). Positive selection collapses the +blast libraries (40-50% zero guides), so library totals would call everything depleted: totals = median_ratio and enrichment is read. Only 10 scrambled controls, so control calibration is weak.
